description.value: Ross Bay Pub is a cozy neighborhood pub on Fairfield Road in Victoria, tucked close to the Dallas Road waterfront and the Fairfield and Oak Bay neighborhoods. It offers food, drinks, daily specials, and community events, positioning itself as a local gathering spot. The location makes it a convenient stop for cyclists exploring the scenic coastal routes of Victoria's south shore.
